selection.candidate_source: Official DLA award/RFQ listing or bounded USAspending prime-contract query, followed to original DLA records
selection.ordering: Eligible candidates by reported cumulative obligation descending; tie-break exact PIID ascending. This is research prioritization, never a fraud ranking.
selection.date_basis_limit: DLA retention refers to posting/latest modification; USAspending delay refers to publication. Award-age screen is an approximation, not a guaranteed availability window. Verify actual dates.
selection.alternative_when_no_overlap: Capture accessible new official award/line documents now and reconcile aggregate records only when actually published. No scheduled background capture created.

price_controls.method: Sum quantity×independent adjusted reference and quantity×contract price within matched strata; report both base and gross denominators. Identify repeated percentage patterns separately from causal conclusions.
price_controls.annualization: Only observed distinct transactions within an explicit period; no ceiling or estimated-quantity substitution.
price_controls.benefit_test: Separate dated decision-maker relationships, steering evidence and documented return benefit. Price difference alone is insufficient.
price_controls.current_seed: Three provisional retailer candidates; no qualified benchmark or actual excess amount.
